note: Block hierarchy for the Studio process-flow viewer. Status and doc paths come from the repo docs (architecture.md, orchestrator/spec.md, adversary/spec.md, context.md D18/D19); verify code paths against the branch before relying on them.

production.label: Production / deployment
production.runtime: none: concept only (D18), static diagram, never shows a live state

blocks.label: Human demo + task
blocks.summary: One video demo and a task text enter the system. DemoSpecs come from hurobo markers or LIBERO demo files.
blocks.details: SAM 3.1 tracking is a stretch goal (D14). The console does not yet drive initial generation; it repairs examples/bowl_on_plate/policy.py.

live.notes: No console event until the /policy-dev wizard exists.

blocks.label: Synthesizer
blocks.summary: Frozen Muse model turns a demo into a program and rewrites it from failure feedback. Nothing is trained.
blocks.details: Entry point synthesize()/rewrite(). A spent token budget raises BudgetExceeded, mapped to a budget stop.

live.notes: Active while a Muse repair call is in flight; only the whole call is visible.

blocks.label: Perception
blocks.summary: Masks, point clouds and scene graph from SAM 3 and depth. Real only with the cap_harness backend and services up.
blocks.details: Console Perception tab shows live/archived/missing layers.

live.notes: Only with --backend cap_harness. The perception_* SSE path had an unresolved bug.

blocks.label: DemoSpec
blocks.summary: Keyframes, object tracks and gripper aperture extracted from the demo.
blocks.details: Converters exist for hurobo and LIBERO demos.

blocks.label: Program generator (Muse)
blocks.summary: Muse writes a plain cap_harness script from the DemoSpec, API signatures and constraints.
blocks.details: Context only: constraints and retrieved guidance.

live.notes: Initial generation is not driven by the console.

blocks.label: Static checks
blocks.summary: AST pre-flight: syntax, call whitelist, only math imports.

blocks.label: Nominal replay
blocks.summary: Develop-and-repair on the nominal seed; only a passing policy becomes attackable.
blocks.details: Otherwise the run ends as no_working_policy and escalates.

blocks.label: Repair rewrite
blocks.summary: MuseOrchestrator runs one blocking muse exec per rewrite with the failure constraint.

live.notes: Active between an attack_event with a failure and the cycle row.

blocks.label: Adversary
blocks.summary: Picks a category, proposes a bounded perturbation, rolls out the policy and diagnoses the failure.
blocks.details: Attack() runs all inner steps synchronously, so the inner blocks cannot be shown live individually.

live.notes: Block-level only: active from the cycle start until attack_event.

blocks.label: Category selector
blocks.summary: Thompson sampling over categories with eta-uniform exploration.

live.notes: Draws are in the attack record.

blocks.label: Perturbation proposer
blocks.summary: M agents propose parameters; severity is clamped to rho in code.

blocks.label: Sandboxed rollout
blocks.summary: Runs the program in mock or cap_harness backend; a crash is ERROR, never a task failure.
blocks.details: Real LIBERO rollouts take about 40 s each.

live.notes: With cap_harness, perception frames stream during the rollout.

blocks.label: Diagnoser
blocks.summary: Model or rule diagnosis into mode, root cause and a constraint.

blocks.label: Failure history
blocks.summary: Append-only attack log and per-category counts.

blocks.label: Orchestrator
blocks.summary: Runs the closed loop: attack, feedback, rewrite, gate, stall and escalation.
blocks.details: Only package that knows both systems.

blocks.label: Regression gate
blocks.summary: Accept a candidate only if no worse on every case and better on at least one.
blocks.details: A crash where the incumbent passed is a regression.

blocks.label: Stall counter
blocks.summary: Counts rejected cycles per failure signature (W=3 default, console uses 2).

blocks.label: Escalation / human gate
blocks.summary: After W stalled cycles, ask a person for one targeted answer that becomes a constraint.

live.notes: Waits on the human, so it is truly live.

blocks.label: Stop rule
blocks.summary: min_tests or posterior mode; also budget stop.

blocks.label: Skill admission and memory
blocks.summary: Promote skills after a gate pass; experience memory. Cut for the hackathon (D18).

blocks.label: Certified skill / report
blocks.summary: summary.json, studio.html and held-out evaluation of v0 vs final.

blocks.label: Task request
blocks.summary: Production entry: a task arrives and a stored policy is chosen.

blocks.label: Run policy on robot
blocks.summary: Execute the certified program on the target.

blocks.label: Failure monitor + recovery
blocks.summary: Detect failures at runtime, run a recovery skill or ask a human.
